about: Marzley Tech Solutions chat knowledge base. Used by the website chat (js/home.js) and the AI assistant (portal/chat.php). Keep answers short, true and in the 'we' voice. Links: site paths like 'pricing#care', full https:// links, or '#callback' to open the call-back form.

entries.title: How much does a website cost?
entries.a: Website packages start at KSh 15,000 for a landing page, KSh 25,000 for a small business site, KSh 40,000 for an online shop (e-commerce) and KSh 60,000 for a corporate site. Every project is quoted to its exact scope, and you can pay in stages.

entries.title: Landing page package
entries.a: The Landing page package (from KSh 15,000) suits startups, personal brands and campaigns: 1–3 responsive pages, a contact page, a WhatsApp button and a modern, mobile-first design. It usually takes about a week.

entries.title: Small business website
entries.a: The Small business package (from KSh 25,000) includes Home, About, Services and Contact pages (4+), Google Maps and social media links, analytics setup, a contact form and a WhatsApp button, all mobile-first.

entries.title: Online shop (e-commerce)
entries.a: Our E-commerce package (from KSh 40,000) gives you a product catalogue, cart and orders, M-Pesa, card and PayPal payments, and live chat and delivery setup. Customers pay with an M-Pesa prompt on their phone and orders update automatically.

entries.title: Corporate / custom website
entries.a: The Corporate package (from KSh 60,000) is for organisations that need a fully custom design, unlimited pages, a database, CRM and integrations, and advanced functionality.

entries.title: Add-ons: domain, logo, SEO, security
entries.a: Add-ons: domain and hosting from KSh 3,000 a year, logo and branding KSh 2,500, SEO optimisation KSh 5,000, and security and backups KSh 3,500.

entries.title: Get a quote
entries.a: Use the quote builder on the pricing page for an instant estimate you can send on WhatsApp or download as a PDF. Or tell us what you need and we’ll send a clear, itemised quote you can accept online. Everything is agreed in writing before work starts.

entries.title: How long does it take?
entries.a: Most landing pages take about a week and business websites a few weeks. Online shops and systems depend on the features. You get a clear timeline with your quote, and having your text and photos ready speeds things up.

entries.title: How we work
entries.a: We work in four steps: 1) Discuss your goals, audience and budget and agree the scope. 2) Design: you review the look before any code is written. 3) Build: we develop the site or system, including payments and admin tools, and share progress. 4) Launch & support: we go live on your domain, show you how to manage it and stay available.

entries.title: How do I pay for my project?
entries.a: A deposit starts the work and the balance is paid in stages as the project progresses. You can pay by M-Pesa (Buy Goods Till 6095737), bank transfer or card. In the client portal you can also pay invoices by M-Pesa or card and pay in parts.

entries.title: Paying the deposit
entries.a: Once you’ve agreed on a package, you can pay the deposit by M-Pesa straight on the site (KSh 5,000, 10,000, 20,000 or another amount) to Till 6095737. You get an M-Pesa receipt by SMS instantly, and the deposit counts toward your final price. Not sure how much? Confirm with us on WhatsApp first.

entries.title: M-Pesa on my website
entries.a: Yes, we add M-Pesa (STK push) to websites and systems. The customer enters their phone number, gets the M-Pesa PIN prompt on their phone, and once they pay Safaricom confirms it and the website updates the order automatically. You can try a real KSh 1 payment on our Services page.

entries.title: Do I need a paybill or till?
entries.a: Yes. Payments go straight to your own till or paybill, never through us. We help you set up the Safaricom Daraja connection your website needs.

entries.title: Card, Paystack and PayPal
entries.a: We integrate Paystack for card and bank payments and PayPal for international payments, alongside M-Pesa. Our own e-commerce shop and client portal take payments this way.

entries.title: Try the M-Pesa demo
entries.a: On our Services page you can make a real KSh 1 M-Pesa payment to see exactly what your customers would experience: the prompt arrives on your phone and the page confirms the payment.

entries.title: Domain and hosting
entries.a: Yes, we set up your domain (like yourbusiness.co.ke) and hosting from KSh 3,000 a year, and deploy the site so it’s live on your own address with https. With a care plan we also track renewal dates and remind you before anything expires.

entries.title: Business email
entries.a: We can advise on professional email on your own domain as part of setting up your hosting. Tell us how many addresses you need and we’ll include it in your quote.

entries.title: Do I own my website?
entries.a: Yes. The domain, hosting account, website files and content are yours, and you get all the logins when the project is done.

entries.title: Will it work on phones?
entries.a: Yes. Every site is designed mobile-first and tested on phones, because most visitors in Kenya browse on mobile data. Pages are kept light so they load fast on slow connections.

entries.title: Can I update the site myself?
entries.a: Yes. We can build on WordPress or add a simple admin area so you can change text, photos and products, and we show you how to use it. Care plans also include time each month for changes we make for you.

entries.title: Showing up on Google (SEO)
entries.a: Every site is built with Google basics in place (fast pages, titles, descriptions, sitemap). For more, SEO optimisation is KSh 5,000, and our free website check shows what to fix on an existing site. Getting on Google Maps also helps local customers find you.

entries.title: Google Maps & Business Profile
entries.a: A free Google Business Profile puts you on Google Maps and in local searches. Our blog has a step-by-step guide, and we can set it up and link it to your website.

entries.title: Free website health check
entries.a: Enter your website’s address in our free health check for an instant report on security, speed, mobile setup and Google basics, with simple tips to fix each issue.

entries.title: Care plans (maintenance)
entries.a: Care plans keep your site safe and up to date: Basic KSh 1,500/month (monthly backups, security updates, uptime monitoring, WhatsApp help), Business KSh 3,500/month (plus weekly backups, up to 1 hour of changes and a monthly speed and SEO check) and Premium KSh 7,500/month (plus daily backups, up to 3 hours of changes and priority 24/7 support). Cancel any time.

entries.title: My site is hacked or broken
entries.a: Sorry to hear that. With a care plan we restore it from a backup and fix the cause. Without one, contact us now and we’ll quote the repair quickly. We work 24/7.

entries.title: What happens after launch?
entries.a: We show you how to manage your site and stay available for support. We fix defects in our work that you report within 30 days of launch at no charge. For ongoing peace of mind, care plans cover backups, updates, security and small changes every month.

entries.title: Security and data safety
entries.a: Every site runs on https with up-to-date software, strong passwords and protected forms and logins. Systems use secure logins, careful permissions and regular backups. Your data belongs to you, is only used for your project, and is handled with Kenya’s Data Protection Act in mind. Payment keys stay on the server, never in website code.

entries.title: Privacy policy
entries.a: Our privacy policy explains what we collect (for example your contact details when you enquire, and payment records), why, who we share it with (like Safaricom for M-Pesa), how long we keep it, and your rights under Kenya’s Data Protection Act.

entries.title: Terms, refunds and contracts
entries.a: Our terms cover quotes, payments, ownership and support. Refunds follow what is agreed in your written quote, and work outside the agreed scope is quoted before we do it.

entries.title: Hospital & clinic systems
entries.a: Yes, we build hospital, clinic and pharmacy systems: patient records, appointments, billing and websites with services and doctors. Past work includes MediFlow HMS, MediCare Hospital and Supreme HMS.

entries.title: School & college systems
entries.a: Yes, we build school and college websites and systems: courses, student information, news, portals and fee payments by M-Pesa. Past work includes the Gatanga TVC website and CBET Planner for TVET trainers.

entries.title: CBET Planner
entries.a: CBET Planner is our online platform for TVET trainers in Kenya. It drafts learning plans, session plans, information sheets and assessments from your curriculum, saving hours of paperwork.

entries.title: BuildPro
entries.a: BuildPro is our platform for architects and building engineers. It takes a project from site survey to drawings, a 3D model, structural design, BQ, materials, costing and documentation in one place.

entries.title: Jobs Connect
entries.a: Jobs Connect is our platform that connects skilled professionals to customers who need work done. It matches you with verified pros nearby and holds your M-Pesa payment in escrow until the job is done. Riders can also enrol to offer deliveries.

entries.title: Wi-Fi hotspot billing
entries.a: We built a Wi-Fi hotspot billing system where customers buy internet packages with M-Pesa and get connected automatically. We can build or adapt one for your business.

entries.title: Business systems
entries.a: Yes, we build custom business systems: sales and stock, booking, CRM, portals and more, each designed around how you work, with M-Pesa payments, secure logins and backups.

entries.title: Mobile app
q: can you make an app for my business
entries.a: Yes. We build web apps, installable progressive web apps (PWAs) and Android apps, with M-Pesa payments and admin dashboards. For most businesses a fast web app is the best first step because it works on every phone without a download; we add an Android app when you need notifications or offline use. You can also download our own Android app.

entries.title: Design, logos & branding
entries.a: We design clean, user-friendly interfaces and visuals: logos and branding (from KSh 2,500), posters and flyers, social media graphics, and photo editing.

entries.title: Redesign my existing website
entries.a: Yes. We redesign existing websites to be faster, clearer and mobile-friendly, and can add payments and admin tools. See the before and after of our own site. Run the free check first to see what needs fixing.

entries.title: Training & courses
entries.a: We run practical, project-based training in web development, programming, and graphic design & UI/UX, plus one-to-one mentorship. Classes run in person and online with weekday, evening and weekend options. Over 200 students trained.

entries.title: Web development course
entries.a: The web development course covers HTML, CSS and responsive design, JavaScript, PHP and MySQL, and hosting and going live, so you finish with real websites published on your own domain.

entries.title: Programming course
entries.a: The programming course teaches problem-solving and programming logic with JavaScript and PHP, working with data and APIs, and projects you can show employers.

entries.title: Graphic design & UI/UX course
entries.a: The graphic design & UI/UX course covers design principles, colour and typography, logos, posters and social media graphics, interface and user experience design, and photo editing.

entries.title: Mentorship & ICT consultation
entries.a: We offer one-to-one mentorship: help with school and personal projects, career guidance in tech, and code and portfolio reviews. We also offer ICT consultation for institutions.

entries.title: Course fees & schedule
entries.a: Classes run in person and online, with weekday, evening and weekend options. Send your details on the training page and we’ll share the current fees and the next start date.

entries.title: Do I need experience?
entries.a: No experience needed. Courses start from the basics and build up with real projects. Tell us your level when you enrol and we’ll place you in the right class.

entries.title: Certificates
entries.a: Yes. Students who complete a course get a certificate with a code that employers can check on our certificate verification page.

entries.title: Client portal
entries.a: Clients and students sign in to the portal with Google to follow project progress, approve designs, send and download files, open support requests, pay invoices by M-Pesa or card, and take courses.

entries.title: Invoices & receipts
entries.a: Your invoices are in the client portal. Pay by M-Pesa or card (in full or in parts), or report a till or bank payment with “I’ve already paid”. Receipts are sent automatically and can be downloaded as PDFs.

entries.title: Referral programme
entries.a: Refer a business, school or clinic: when they become a client and pay their deposit, you get KSh 2,000 by M-Pesa or off your next invoice. Get your personal link in seconds.

entries.title: Contact details
entries.a: Call or WhatsApp +254 745 789 590, or email info@marzleytechsolutions.co.ke. You can also use the contact form, book a free call, or ask us to call you back.

entries.title: Opening hours
entries.a: We’re available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including evenings and weekends. Message us anytime on WhatsApp.

entries.title: Where are you?
entries.a: We’re based in Kenya and work with clients across the country online, by phone and WhatsApp, and in person where needed.

entries.title: Book a free call
entries.a: Book a free 15-minute call by phone, WhatsApp or Google Meet at a time that suits you, including evenings and weekends. We confirm your slot within the hour.

entries.title: Call me back
entries.a: Sure, leave your name and number and we’ll call you back shortly.

entries.title: About Marzley Tech
entries.a: Marzley Tech Solutions was founded by Kelvin Wanyoike, known as Marzley, a web and app developer, designer, ICT trainer, digital skills facilitator and Jitume facilitator based in Kenya. We build websites, apps and systems across industries (hospitals, schools, construction, e-commerce, businesses) and train students in IT and programming.

entries.title: Past work & portfolio
entries.a: Our work includes CBET Planner, hospital systems (MediFlow HMS, MediCare, Supreme HMS), the Gatanga TVC website, Umoja Welfare, an e-commerce shop with M-Pesa and Paystack, a Wi-Fi hotspot billing system and business websites.

entries.title: Technologies we use
entries.a: We work with HTML, CSS and JavaScript on the front end, PHP and MySQL on the back end, WordPress for easy content editing, and M-Pesa, Paystack and PayPal for payments, with secure hosting and deployment.

entries.title: Integrations
entries.a: We connect websites to M-Pesa (Daraja STK push), Paystack, PayPal, WhatsApp chat and order messages, Google Maps, Analytics and sign-in, WordPress, email notifications and MySQL databases.

entries.title: Website or just Facebook?
entries.a: Social media is great for reach, but a website gives you a professional address you own, shows up on Google, takes payments and works even if an account is suspended. Our blog explains when you need one.

entries.title: Blog & guides
entries.a: Our blog has practical guides on website costs in Kenya, M-Pesa payments, Google Maps, school systems, care plans and getting paid faster.

entries.title: Case studies
entries.a: Read how we built CBET Planner and the Gatanga TVC website: the problem, the approach and what each system does today.

entries.title: Kiswahili
entries.a: Karibu! Tunazungumza Kiswahili. Unaweza kusoma kuhusu huduma zetu kwa Kiswahili au kutuandikia WhatsApp.

entries.title: Website analytics
entries.a: Small business packages and above include analytics setup, so you can see how many people visit, which pages they read and where they come from.

entries.title: Changes & revisions
entries.a: You review and approve the design before any code is written, and you can request changes through the client portal. Work outside the agreed scope is quoted before we do it.

entries.title: Cheaper options
entries.a: We keep prices clear and fair. You can start small with a landing page from KSh 15,000 and grow later, and you pay in stages rather than all at once. Tell us your budget and we’ll suggest the best option.

entries.title: Churches, NGOs & welfare groups
entries.a: Yes, we build websites for churches, NGOs, welfare groups, SACCOs and chamas, with news, events, member information and M-Pesa contributions. Past work includes the Umoja Welfare site.

entries.title: Talk to a person
entries.a: Of course. Message us on WhatsApp or ask for a call back and a real person will reply quickly, day or night.

entries.title: Are payments safe?
entries.a: Yes. Payments go to our registered Till 6095737 and you get an M-Pesa receipt by SMS instantly. You only ever enter your PIN on your own phone. You get a written quote before paying, and every payment is receipted in the client portal.

entries.title: Free learning hub
q: Where can I learn coding for free?
How do I unlock a video?
entries.a: Our free learning hub has 46 subjects and 560+ lessons: coding with a live editor (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL) plus PHP, Java, C, C++, C#, TypeScript, Dart/Flutter and Go; web design and Canva graphic design; Excel, Word, PowerPoint, email and Google Drive, AI tools, eCitizen and KRA iTax, computer maintenance and online safety; networking with CIDR and subnetting calculators, Linux, Git, cybersecurity, web hosting, digital marketing, and how to make money online (freelancing, getting paid to M-Pesa, avoiding scams). Practice questions check themselves and no account is needed. Video lessons need a free account and are unlocked with M-Pesa.

entries.title: Jitume facilitator
entries.a: Yes. Kelvin Wanyoike (Marzley) is a Jitume facilitator. Jitume is a Government of Kenya digital skills initiative with digital labs in colleges, universities and communities that trains young people for digital and online work. Kelvin also runs digital skills sessions for schools, colleges, youth groups and staff teams.

entries.title: Digital skills facilitator
q: Can you train our staff in digital skills?
Do you run digital skills workshops?
entries.a: Yes. Kelvin is a digital skills facilitator: we run hands-on sessions on computer literacy, Excel, online safety, AI tools, earning online and coding for schools, TVET colleges, youth groups and businesses, in person or online. Call 0745 789 590 to plan a session.

entries.title: Web developer in Kenya
q: Are you the best web developer in Kenya?
entries.a: There’s no official ranking, so compare us on what matters: live work you can open today (CBET Planner, BuildPro, Jobs Connect and more), clear written prices from KSh 15,000, M-Pesa and SEO built in, you own your domain and logins, and support after launch.
